whoApply.title: Who should apply
whoApply.intro: Our suppliers sell Bio Vera products and Bio Vera packaging in their country. We prefer partners who already work in agriculture and have a strong presence across the country.
bullets: You sell our products (seeds, inputs) to growers
You sell our packaging to producers
Ideally you already work in agriculture
Wide presence in your country is an advantage

yourRole.title: Your role
yourRole.intro: As our supplier you advise and train users on the ground. You are the local point of contact for producers and support them with on-site guidance. You also procure packaging for our users – including boxes for packing produce – so they have what they need locally.
bullets: On-site advising and training of users
Procure packaging for our users (e.g. boxes for packing)
First point of contact for farmers in your region

benefits.title: What you get
benefits.subtitle: Benefits of becoming a Bio Vera supplier

cards.title: Guaranteed offtake
cards.description: Guaranteed offtake from our producers in your country. Our growers source from approved suppliers – you get stable demand and predictable revenue.

cards.title: Our products & packaging
cards.description: You sell Bio Vera products and Bio Vera packaging. One brand, one standard, full traceability via QR and the Vera system.

cards.title: Price stability
cards.description: Pre-agreed pricing structure. No price fluctuations or negotiations per transaction. Predictable margins.

cards.title: Integrated logistics
cards.description: Receive seeds and fertilizers on return trips from our logistics network. Fewer empty kilometers, lower costs.

cards.title: National coverage preferred
cards.description: We prefer suppliers with strong national presence. Expand your reach and represent Bio Vera across your country.

cards.title: Exclusive market access
cards.description: Direct access to our producer network and to the German market through our vertically integrated chain.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Understanding the Bio Vera supply chain

steps.title: Sourcing from approved partners
steps.body: Suppliers procure goods from our approved partners within the country. They also source packaging (e.g. boxes for packing) for our users. Seeds, fertilizers, and packaging meet Bio Vera specifications.

steps.title: Agreed Pricing Structure
steps.body: All products are sold at pre-agreed prices. This ensures price stability for growers and predictable revenue for suppliers. No price fluctuations or negotiations per transaction.

steps.title: Distribution to Growers
steps.body: Suppliers distribute products to Bio Vera certified growers in their region. Every transaction is tracked through QR codes, ensuring complete traceability from supplier to field.

steps.title: Digital Tracking & Compliance
steps.body: All inventory movements are recorded in the Vera Admin Dashboard. Suppliers maintain real-time visibility of stock levels, and the system automatically alerts when inventory falls below 20% threshold.

howItWorks.forSuppliersPanelIntro: As a supplier, you purchase from our approved partners and sell to growers at the agreed price. You maintain local inventory, procure packaging (e.g. boxes) for our users, and provide regional support to farmers.
forSuppliersPanelBullets: Procure packaging (e.g. boxes for packing) for our users
Distribute to growers at fixed prices
Track all transactions via QR codes

requirements.title: Program Requirements
requirements.subtitle: What we expect from our suppliers

cards.title: Vera Resources Storage
cards.description: Obligation to provide dry and secure storage space for Vera seeds, fertilizers, and packaging materials.

cards.title: QR Code Issuance
cards.description: Supplier cannot issue goods without scanning the QR code from the farmer's app. This is the only way to track consumption per hectare.

cards.title: Local Support
cards.description: Supplier is the first point of contact for farmers in their region. They perform physical verification of received goods and provide on-site advice and training.

cards.title: Inventory Reporting
cards.description: System must automatically notify headquarters in Hamburg when inventory falls below 20%.

requirements.commonBody: All partners must use the Vera Admin Dashboard to record every entry and exit of goods. No 'paperwork' – everything must be in the digital system.

logistics.title: Vera Logistics Advantage
logistics.subtitle: Smart return logistics system

steps.title: Pickup & Delivery
steps.body: Driver picks up products from growers and delivers them to the buyer's address.

steps.title: Return Pickup
steps.body: On the return trip, the driver picks up our Vera seeds and fertilizers from our partners.

steps.title: Distribution to Suppliers
steps.body: The driver delivers Vera seeds and fertilizers directly to our suppliers on the return route, eliminating empty kilometers.

logistics.supplierColumnIntro: Receive regular deliveries of Vera seeds and fertilizers directly from our partners, delivered by our logistics network on return trips.
supplierColumnBullets: No need to arrange separate transport for incoming goods
Reduced logistics costs through integrated system
logistics.systemColumnIntro: Our smart logistics system ensures maximum efficiency by eliminating empty return trips and optimizing every kilometer of transport.
systemColumnBullets: Zero empty kilometers on return trips
Reduced fuel costs and environmental impact
Faster delivery times through optimized routes

application.title: Supplier Application
application.intro: Apply online (no self-service store login). You receive a reference code to track your application. Our team will contact you to schedule a meeting; when you are approved we create your partner store account.
application.receivedBody: We will contact you to schedule a conversation. Save your reference number — you can use it to check your application status anytime.
